contentItem.title: 平面角：相交两线之间的倾斜
contentItem.englishTitle: A plane angle is the inclination to one another of two lines in a plane which meet one another and do not lie in a straight line.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A plane angle is the inclination to one another of two lines in a plane which meet one another and do not lie in a straight line.
平面角度是平面中两行的对立倾向,它们相互相交,不位于直线。（相关点与线段：A）
